build_slam_service: build a Pyro4 SLAM server that registers a SLAM object on the robot network
create_slam_instance: create a SLAM instance with a robot proxy, map size, resolution, and obstacle threshold
update_map: update the SLAM map using the robot's current PCD, RGB, depth, and semantic data
get_traversable_map: get the traversable map showing areas free of obstacles for robot navigation
add_obstacles: add obstacles at given locations in real or map coordinates to the SLAM map
